rows.body: SITUATION

rows.title: A global B2B platform used for onboarding, ordering, service management, and account visibility needed to improve adoption across customers and internal sales teams.
CONSTRAINT
rows.body: Core backend workflows could not be changed immediately. Any redesign had to work inside phased rollout and existing architecture realities.
INTERVENTION

rows.title: Started with UI, usability, and heuristic audits. Then redesigned the UI, built a scalable design system, and fixed all UI issues plus around 50% of usability issues not blocked by backend constraints.
WHY IT MATTERS
rows.body: Shows how adoption can improve without waiting for full backend transformation.
